LUCI.TITLE: Luci IA
LUCI.SUBTITLE: Your support assistant. Changes here take effect on the next message.
LUCI.NO_INBOX: Not linked to any inbox yet — link her under Settings, Bots

SKILLS.TITLE: What she can do on her own
SKILLS.SUBTITLE: She decides when to use each one — no configuration needed.

RECORD.TITLE: Record details
RECORD.BODY: Saves the event type, date and notes onto the conversation as the client mentions them.

CLASSIFY.TITLE: Classify
CLASSIFY.BODY: Tags the conversation as quote, question, complaint, scheduling or after-sales.

HANDOFF.TITLE: Call a human
HANDOFF.BODY: Steps aside and returns the conversation to the team queue when it needs a person.

LUCI.PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: Who Luci is, how she writes, what she must never say, and when to call a human.
LUCI.PROMPT_HINT: Her personality and rules. Be specific about when she should hand a conversation over.
LUCI.KNOWLEDGE_PLACEHOLDER: Services, how the process works, frequently asked questions, what she must not promise.
LUCI.KNOWLEDGE_HINT: What she knows about the company. The longer it gets, the cheaper each message becomes — this part is cached.
LUCI.LABEL: Label that activates her
LUCI.LABEL_HINT: Add this label to a conversation and Luci takes part. Remove it and she stops.

MODEL_COST.OPUS: Most capable, about five times Haiku.
